The FloPlast push-fit 2-boss single socket access pipe is a crucial component for efficient soil and vent drainage systems. Constructed from robust uPVC, this 110mm black access pipe offers strength, durability, and a lightweight design for easy handling during installation. It is ideal for residential plumbing projects where reliable access for system testing and ongoing maintenance of the soil stack is required. Featuring a secure push-fit connection and ring seal joints for leak-free performance, this pipe includes two 67mm boss inlets to accommodate 32, 40, and 50mm waste pipes via adaptors. The use of silicone lubricant on all seals will facilitate jointing.
